name: Yanagawa Amane
source: [url=http://vndb.org/c6702]Shiori's[/url] eldest sister. She tries very hard to make her younger brother Shiori and her younger sister [url=http://vndb.org/c6699]Misaki[/url] to act responsibly. She'll sometimes lecture them when they do bad things. She's very sweet and protective of Shiori. She loves kissing him to wake him up and sometimes even in front of others at school.
